title: Neither the spec nor the diff addresses the GIG_CHAIN / GIG_FACILITATOR_URL precondition that actually determines whether the disbursement settles on Base mainnet vs. Base Sepolia testnet
description: defaultDisburse (lending-orchestrator.mjs line 174) defaults `facilitatorUrl` to `process.env.GIG_FACILITATOR_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8405"`, and payViaFacilitator's own chain/usdcAddress/rpcUrl selection (escrow.mjs lines 31, 44-49) is driven entirely by `GIG_CHAIN` (default 'base-sepolia', testnet, unless explicitly set to 'base'). Per this same repo's own skills/economy/gig/WITNESS-RUNBOOK.md (lines 217, 227, 236, 254), port 8405 is the documented TESTNET facilitator and port 8407 is the documented MAINNET facilitator -- going live requires the lender's own per-instance env to explicitly set both `GIG_CHAIN=base` and `GIG_FACILITATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8407`. This fix's own behavioral-spec.md never mentions this precondition at all (its 'Non-functional requirements' section only covers money-safety-of-the-key and fail-closed key resolution), and no test in wake-gate.test.mjs or lending-orchestrator.test.mjs asserts anything about GIG_CHAIN/GIG_FACILITATOR_URL. Since this review is explicitly gating 'the colony's FIRST real on-chain loan', and the manifest asks to trace the full disburse path for exactly that loan, this is a load-bearing precondition this feature's own spec and tests are silent on: if the lender's env is missing GIG_CHAIN=base or still points GIG_FACILITATOR_URL at 8405, the 'first real loan' could silently settle against testnet (worthless) or fail signature verification (escrow.mjs lines 33-43 document the exact 'FiatTokenV2: invalid signature' failure mode from a domain-name/chain mismatch) rather than genuinely moving real USDC on Base mainnet as the manifest claims will happen.

additionalEvidence.note: GIG_CHAIN defaults to base-sepolia unless explicitly overridden to 'base'
documents 8405=testnet / 8407=mainnet facilitator port convention and the GIG_CHAIN=base + GIG_FACILITATOR_URL=8407 go-live requirement
Non-functional requirements section covers key money-safety only, never GIG_CHAIN/GIG_FACILITATOR_URL
